one_line: An unboxing that opens on the child's "וואו", then shows every part of the kit in real use.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 handheld close shot: a boy about 5, mouth open, hands tearing tissue paper; 0:01 he presses a plastic-wrapped teal workbook with a pencil character on the cover. Heard (transcript): "וואו!". No text on screen.
q1_hook.why: A child's "wow" over a package is a real surprise cue (K1, H1), and the product is handled by 0:01 (S1). But no text or adult voice says what it is (T3, H4, H6), so the viewer learns it is a learn-to-read kit only from the title page at 0:09 (H2).

beats.what: Child tears tissue, presses the plastic-wrapped workbook; "וואו!" (transcript)
beats.why: Surprise and the package, with no explanation.

beats.what: Book unwrapped; a cloth bag, a stitched card and a word page come out
beats.why: The contents of the set appear one by one.

beats.what: Top-down page flips: title page, contents, a road path with letters, word search, matching
beats.why: A quick tour shows the range of tasks.

beats.what: He points across a colourful letter-and-vowel board with a train header
beats.why: The main tool is shown in use.

beats.what: Soft dissolve; he draws marker lines to match pictures with letters
beats.why: A new task and a new tool, markers.

beats.what: He writes first letters under pictures with a pencil
beats.why: Writing, a different skill from matching.

beats.what: He colours words in a house drawing; the Reel ends mid-task
beats.why: A calm, focused finish, not a peak.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "שלחי לי הודעה או כתבי לי בתגובות ואשלח לך קישור לחוברת💖". Nothing in the video asks for a comment, send or save.
q2_flow.why: A new task every 5 to 9 s, each a new picture, keeps it moving and reads as real use (R3, F8). The unboxing opens a "what is inside" question that the tour answers (H5). At 43 s with no text or voice, nothing states a promise, and the last 12 s repeat one kind of task (R1, R2).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no text, no speech. Caption, last line: "שלחי לי הודעה או כתבי לי בתגובות ואשלח לך קישור לחוברת💖".
q3_cta.why: Two routes, message or comment, with no fixed word to type, so two actions (C1), though the reward is a link (C3). It sits only in the caption, and the video ends mid-task with nothing said or shown (C6).

q4_shown.what: A boy about 5 at a wooden table: tearing tissue, unwrapping a workbook, a cloth bag and stitched card, the title page and contents, a colourful letter-and-vowel board with cards, markers, matching, writing and colouring pages. No price, brand name or text overlay.
q4_shown.why: Every part of the set is shown handled in real use for the whole Reel (S1, K5, F8), and the opening "wow" is a real reaction (K8). Nothing shows a result, and the brand and price are absent (C7, S3). A child's face and hands on screen is what LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: Long handheld takes joined by one cut at 4.1 s and a soft dissolve at about 0:26. The angle moves from side-on to top-down. No speed change, no text, no voice after the first second. Ends mid-task on the colouring.
q5_edit.why: Few cuts keep each task in context and look unedited (E6, E2), but 5 to 12 s per task with no text or voice leaves the viewer to work out what is learned (R3, E4, T1). There is no payoff or end card (E8, R4).

q6_topic.what: A child unboxes and works through a learn-to-read activity kit during the summer break; serves a parent of a 5-year-old looking for fun, useful activities.
q6_topic.why: Summer break and the year before school is a dated buying moment (K7) and a real concern, keeping a child busy and learning (K6). The caption's "fun and teaches" claim is modest (K4). Opening a package is a joyful moment that fades into calm work (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone held by an adult beside or above the child at a wooden home table, daylight. Side-on then top-down and over-the-shoulder angles. A real mess in frame: snacks, wipes, markers, a bottle. Child's face partly seen.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down and over-the-shoulder views put the viewer in the child's seat and keep the pages and the board readable (F5, F4). A real, messy table in daylight is very native (H8, F7), though the clutter competes. Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No headline, label, subtitle or CTA text in any frame. The only readable words are the kit's own printed pages, such as the title page at 0:09 ("פשוט וכיף" and the contents).
q8_text.caption: "החופש הגדול כבר כאן, ואם את מחפשת פעילות שהיא גם מהנה וגם מלמדת...". About 55 words in three short paragraphs: summer break, the child's age and the school year ahead, the message-or-comment ask. No hashtags, no brand name, no disclosure line.
q8_text.why: With no text or speech the Reel cannot be understood muted or skimmed, and nothing names the topic, the age or the benefit (T1, T3, H6). The caption does all the work with the occasion and age (T7), but names neither the brand nor the partnership (S7, T8).

weak_points: No text, voice or CTA, so muted it names nothing; no brand or price on screen; 43 s of similar tasks; the child's face and hands shown; clutter on the table; no payoff; partnership not stated in words.
lumebook_takeaway: Film an unboxing top-down with hands only, each part of the order shown in use, a headline in the first second and a CTA on the last frame.
not_verified: Whether the brand name is on the pack (the frames show only the cover and title page); the audio beyond the first second (the transcript's "תודה רבה" lines from 0:30 are false outputs); music; whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed in the post data, no label, no word in the caption). Corrections to the first pass: the child's face is partly seen (top of the frame at 0:00, head at 0:36 to 0:42), not hands only. Plays 1,145, likes 11 on 15 Oct are context only.
